title: Seabed Cobalt Holds 4x Land Reserves As Claims Multiply
hook: Seabed cobalt could dwarf land reserves, but countries want a pause.
closing: The race could reshape battery supply before the world agrees who should dig.
question: Should seabed mining proceed?

segments.say: Seabed mining contracts reached 31, nearly four times the early count. The ocean-floor race is already crowded.
Seabed nodules hold 44 million tonnes of cobalt, four times all land reserves. That is the mining prize.
Countries seeking a seabed mining pause reached 37. Opposition is growing alongside the rush.
